name: Pork katsu don
steps: Coat the pork loin in flour, egg, then panko.
Fry in hot oil until golden and cooked through, then slice.
Simmer sliced onion in dashi, soy sauce, and mirin for a few minutes.
Lay the pork in the simmering broth and pour beaten egg over the top.
Cover briefly until the egg just sets, then slide over the hot rice.
